connection_condition: A district owns the schools that carry it: the district is identified by the county+district prefix of the CDS code and by the district name repeated on each school record; each district also has its own administrative record whose CDS code ends in seven zeros.
description: A district is composed of the schools it operates. A school record cannot be interpreted without the district that operates it, and district-level measures are obtained by aggregating their schools.

connection_condition: The first two digits of the CDS code are the county code, and the county name is repeated on each district and school record.
description: A county is composed of the districts located in it; a district belongs to exactly one county, and county-level results aggregate their districts and schools.

connection_condition: Both counts are reported on the same frpm record and in the same K-12 or ages 5-17 universe; the free-meal count is not greater than the FRPM count on 9930 of 9986 records.
description: Students eligible for free meals are a subset of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, so the free meal count is a narrower measure of the same population as the FRPM count. A small number of records report a free meal count above the FRPM count, which is inconsistent with the subset reading.

connection_condition: The rate is formed from the free meal count on the same record and the same enrollment universe.
description: The eligible free meal rate is derived from the free meal count as its numerator; the free meal population determines the magnitude of the rate for a school.

connection_condition: The rate is formed from K-12 enrollment on the same record as its denominator.
description: The eligible free meal rate is derived from K-12 enrollment as its denominator, so the same free meal count yields a smaller rate at a school with larger enrollment.

connection_condition: The rate is formed from the FRPM count on the same record.
description: The eligible FRPM rate is derived from the free or reduced-price meal count as its numerator.

connection_condition: The rate is formed from K-12 enrollment on the same record as its denominator.
description: The eligible FRPM rate is derived from K-12 enrollment as its denominator for the same enrollment universe as the count.

connection_condition: Both enrollment columns are read from the same frpm record.
description: The enrollment difference uses K-12 enrollment as the minuend; it is derived from the two enrollment count columns rather than stored.

connection_condition: Both enrollment columns are read from the same frpm record.
description: The enrollment difference uses ages 5-17 enrollment as the subtrahend against the same school's K-12 enrollment.

connection_condition: School-level and district-level rows are distinguished by the reporting type on the SAT row, and district membership is carried by the district name on that row.
description: The district average of math averages is derived from the school-level SAT math averages by taking their unweighted mean per district, which differs from an enrollment- or test-taker-weighted average.

connection_condition: The two column pairs sit on the same schools record, and the full-form values coincide on 14403 of 17686 records; the abbreviated pair mirrors the same addresses.
description: The street address and the mailing address are treated as the same business concept of a school's postal street address, so a request for a postal street address can be satisfied from either column, although they are physically distinct columns that may differ.
